errors.text_span: und der längste ist "Indien" mit einem Wert von 41,1
errors.evidence: The longest bar in the chart corresponds to "Irland" (Ireland) with a value of 67.7, not "Indien" (India) with a value of 41.1.

errors.text_span: Die Länder "Kroatien", "China", "Polen" und "Indien" werden durch blaue Balken dargestellt, während der Rest der Länder durch andere Farbtöne dargestellt wird.
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly describes the color mapping. In the chart, all countries have light blue bars except for "Deutschland" (Germany), which has a purple bar. The description incorrectly implies that only four countries are blue and the other six have different colors.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind absteigend nach dem jeweiligen Wert sortiert.
errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted in a single descending order. They are organized into two groups: negative values (top) and positive values (bottom). Within each group, the bars are sorted in ascending order (from most negative to least negative, and from least positive to most positive).
